entries.french_reference: Je ne suis pas perdu, je te dis !\nJe campe ! Voilà mon histoire !
entries.portuguese: Já disse que não me perdi!\nEstou acampando! É isso!

entries.english: Where am I? Am I lost?\nWho are you?<0xFB>Are you a Pokémon Trainer?

entries.portuguese: Certo, somos Treinadores.\nJá é um começo, né?

entries.english: I just wanted to have a picnic in\nThundercap Mt.<0xFB>I didn't think I would get lost\nin a place like this"

entries.english: What every good picnic needs is a\ncute setting, good food, and a<0xFA>fun battle!
entries.french_reference: Un bon pique-nique, c'est un joli\ndécor, de bons plats, et\lun combat sympa !

entries.english: That wasn't any fun for me!

entries.french_reference: Tu t'es juste moqué de moi !

for weeks trying to learn more<0xFA>about this ancient tomb.<0xFB>Unfortunately, this puzzle here has
us stumped.<0xFB>If you think you'll have a better
chance at solving it than we did,<0xFA>then be my guest.

bloque.\pSi tu penses avoir plus de chances
que nous de le résoudre,\lalors je t'en prie.

entries.english:
This is it"
The burial chamber!<0xFB>And look!<0xFB>That must be where the ancient king
of Borrius is buried.<0xFB>Now that we've made it, let's
gather up as much treasure as we<0xFA>can, then get out of here.<0xFB>And just in case there are still
traps waiting to be sprung, let me<0xFA>use the last of my healing items on<0xFA>your Pokémon.
entries.french_reference:
C'est ça…
La chambre funéraire !\pEt regarde !\pC'est là que l'ancien roi de
Borrius est enterré.\pMaintenant qu'on y est, prenons
un maximum de trésors\lpossible, puis sortons d'ici.\pEt au cas où il resterait des
pièges prêts à se déclencher,\llaisse-moi utiliser mes derniers
objets de soin sur\ltes Pokémon.
entries.portuguese:
É aqui<0xB0>

o antigo rei de Borrius.<0xFB>Agora que chegamos, vamos
juntar o máximo de tesouro<0xFA>e sair daqui.<0xFB>Se ainda houver armadilhas,
é melhor usar meus últimos<0xFA>itens de cura<0xFA>nos seus Pokémon.

entries.english:
It seems your fight with that
ancient Pokémon unlocked the<0xFA>seal on the door.<0xFB>Looks like my colleague was right
about that door leading to the<0xFA>burial chamber, after all.<0xFB>Well, I'd best report back to the
Archeology Society with the<0xFA>treasure and knowledge I gathered.<0xFB>But before I go, I picked this up
while we were making our way<0xFA>through the tomb.<0xFB>At first glance, I thought it was
ancient treasure, but it's just one<0xFA>of those Z-Crystals all the kids<0xFA>are into these days.<0xFB>Here, you can have it.
entries.french_reference:
On dirait que ton combat contre ce
Pokémon antique a levé\lle sceau de la porte.\pOn dirait que mon collègue avait
raison sur cette porte menant\là la chambre funéraire, finalement.\pBon, je ferais mieux de prévenir la
Société d'Archéologie avec le\ltrésor et les savoirs acquis.\pMais avant de partir, j'ai ramassé
ça en traversant\lle tombeau.\pAu premier regard, j'ai cru que
c'était un trésor ancien, mais c'est\lun de ces Z-Cristaux dont les\ljeunes raffolent aujourd'hui.\pTiens, tu peux le garder.
entries.portuguese:
Sua luta com aquele Pokémon
antigo parece ter rompido<0xFA>o selo da porta.<0xFB>Meu colega tinha razão:
aquela porta leva mesmo<0xFA>à câmara funerária.<0xFB>Preciso voltar e mostrar
à Archeology Society<0xFA>o tesouro e o que aprendi.<0xFB>Mas, antes de ir, achei isto
enquanto caminhávamos<0xFA>pela tumba.<0xFB>Parecia um tesouro antigo,
mas é só um dos Z-Crystals<0xFA>que a garotada tanto<0xFA>adora hoje em dia.<0xFB>Tome, pode ficar com ele.

entries.english:
Long ago, there was a readable
inscription on the tablet below.<0xFB>However, it appears it has long
since eroded away.<0xFB>From what I remember, I believe it
said something along the lines of:<0xFB>PRESSING THE SWITCH WITH INSECT
IS THE KEY.<0xFB>What ever could that mean?
entries.french_reference:
Autrefois, il y avait une
inscription lisible sur la tablette.\pMais elle semble s'être érodée
depuis longtemps.\pDe mémoire, il était écrit
quelque chose comme :\pPRESSER L'INTERRUPTEUR AVEC
INSECTE EST LA CLÉ.\pQu'est-ce que ça peut vouloir dire ?
entries.portuguese:
Há muito tempo, dava para ler

há muito tempo.<0xFB>Pelo que me lembro,
era algo assim:<0xFB>APERTE O BOTÃO COM INSETO.

entries.english: It's an ingenious design, really.<0xFB>To test Trainers' strength, the\ndesigners of Victory Road set up<0xFA>a puzzle that must be solved in<0xFA>order to progress any further.<0xFB>That way, those lacking conviction\nare forced to turn back.
entries.french_reference: Le dispositif est ingénieux.\pPour tester les Dresseurs,\nles créateurs ont installé un puzzle\là résoudre\lpour avancer.\pAinsi, ceux qui manquent de courage\nsont forcés de faire demi-tour.
entries.portuguese: É um projeto genial, mesmo.<0xFB>Para testar os Treinadores,\nos criadores de Victory Road<0xFA>puseram um enigma que deve<0xFA>ser resolvido para avançar.<0xFB>Assim, quem não tem convicção\né obrigado a voltar.

entries.english: Life is all about overcoming\nhurdles!<0xFB>Could you be a hurdle for me?
entries.french_reference: La vie, c'est surmonter\ndes obstacles !\pSerais-tu un obstacle pour moi ?
entries.portuguese: A vida é superar\nobstáculos!<0xFB>Será um obstáculo para mim?

entries.english: I couldn't overcome the hurdle you\npresented to me"
entries.french_reference: Je n'ai pas surmonté l'obstacle\nque tu m'as imposé…
entries.portuguese: Não consegui superar\no obstáculo que você foi<0xB0>

entries.english: If you can't overcome a hurdle, you\ncan always just go around it.<0xFB>Keep going, and you'll find the\ngreatest hurdle for Trainers:<0xFA>the Pokémon League.
entries.french_reference: Si tu ne peux pas surmonter\nun obstacle, contourne-le.\pContinue, et tu trouveras\nle plus grand obstacle :\lla Ligue Pokémon.
entries.portuguese: Se não superar um obstáculo,\nvocê pode contorná-lo.<0xFB>Siga e encontrará o maior\nobstáculo dos Treinadores:<0xFA>a Liga Pokémon.

entries.english: Why don't you prove to me how much\nyour Pokémon are capable of?
entries.french_reference: Montre-moi de quoi\ntes Pokémon sont capables.
entries.portuguese: Que tal me mostrar do que\nseus Pokémon são capazes?

entries.english: They are capable of far more than\nwe are!<0xFB>That has certainly been proven!
entries.french_reference: Ils sont capables de bien plus\nque nous !\pC'est bien prouvé !
entries.portuguese: Eles podem fazer muito\nmais do que nós!<0xFB>Isso ficou bem claro!

entries.english: There actually wasn't any need to\nprove how strong we are.<0xFB>I already know how capable my\nPokémon and I are!
entries.french_reference: Pas besoin de prouver\nà quel point on est forts.\pJe sais déjà de quoi mes\nPokémon et moi sommes capables !
entries.portuguese: Nem era preciso provar\ncomo somos fortes.<0xFB>Já sei do que meus\nPokémon e eu somos capazes!

entries.english: You"\nWho's brought you this far?
entries.french_reference: Toi…\nQui t'a mené si loin ?
entries.portuguese: Você<0xB0>\nQuem te trouxe até aqui?

entries.english: It's your reliable Pokémon who\nbrought you this far, isn't it?
entries.french_reference: Ce sont tes Pokémon fidèles qui\nt'ont mené si loin, non ?
entries.portuguese: Foram seus Pokémon fiéis\nque te trouxeram até aqui, né?

entries.english: You know what I think?<0xFB>All people know what they can do\nalone, but"<0xFB>There are a lot of things you can\nonly do with Pokémon, too!
entries.french_reference: Tu sais ce que je pense ?\pTout le monde sait ce qu'il peut\nfaire seul, mais…\pIl y a bien des choses qu'on\nne peut faire qu'avec des Pokémon !
entries.portuguese: Sabe o que eu acho?<0xFB>Todos sabem o que conseguem\nfazer sozinhos, mas<0xB0><0xFB>Também há muita coisa que só\ndá para fazer com Pokémon!

entries.english: Each day, different Trainers try\nto push a boulder past me!
entries.french_reference: Chaque jour, des Dresseurs tentent\nde pousser un rocher devant moi !
entries.portuguese: Todo dia, Treinadores tentam\nempurrar uma pedra por mim!

entries.english: These Trainers are like you, they\ndesire to become the very best.
entries.french_reference: Ces Dresseurs sont comme toi,\nils veulent devenir les meilleurs.
entries.portuguese: Eles são como você,\nquerem ser os melhores.

entries.english: Do you aim to be the very best?<0xFB>The very best Trainers know how to\nuse their Pokémon's muscles to<0xFA>move boulders around!
entries.french_reference: Tu veux être le meilleur ?\pLes meilleurs Dresseurs savent\nutiliser la force de leurs Pokémon\lpour faire bouger des rochers !
entries.portuguese: Quer ser o melhor de todos?<0xFB>Os melhores Treinadores sabem\nusar os músculos dos Pokémon<0xFA>para mover pedras!

entries.english: I see no end to the endless battles\nin front of me.<0xFB>Even if you defeat me, which you\nwon't, I'll never stop!
entries.french_reference: Je ne vois pas la fin des combats\nqui m'attendent.\pMême si tu me bats, ce qui\nn'arrivera pas, je ne cesserai pas !
entries.portuguese: Não vejo fim para as batalhas\nsem fim que me esperam.<0xFB>Mesmo que me vença, o que não\nvai acontecer, nunca pararei!

entries.english: Well, that didn't go the way I\nwanted it to!
entries.french_reference: Bon, ça ne s'est pas passé\ncomme je voulais !
entries.portuguese: Bem, isso não saiu\ncomo eu queria!

entries.english: How do you stop me from fighting\nyou?<0xFB>Push that boulder onto the pressure\nplate, and I will no longer have a<0xFA>reason to fight.
entries.french_reference: Comment me faire arrêter de te\ncombattre ?\pPousse ce rocher sur la plaque de\npression et je n'aurai plus de\lraison de me battre.
entries.portuguese: Como me fazer parar\nde lutar com você?<0xFB>Empurre a pedra para a placa\nde pressão e não terei mais<0xFA>motivo para lutar.

entries.english: This room" I can guarantee it is\nnot a natural formation.
entries.french_reference: Cette salle… Je peux garantir que\nce n'est pas naturel.
entries.portuguese: Esta sala<0xB0> Garanto que\nnão é uma formação natural.

entries.english: The formation here is staggering"
entries.french_reference: La formation ici est stupéfiante…
entries.portuguese: A formação daqui é espantosa<0xB0>

entries.english: The puzzle in this room isn't part\nof the Victory Road puzzle.<0xFB>It has been around for much, much\nlonger.<0xFB>Who could have set it up, I wonder?
entries.french_reference: L'énigme de cette salle ne fait pas\npartie de la Route Victoire.\pElle existe depuis bien plus\nlongtemps.\pQui a bien pu la mettre en place ?
entries.portuguese: O enigma desta sala não faz\nparte do de Victory Road.<0xFB>Ele existe há muito,\nmuito mais tempo.<0xFB>Quem será que o criou?

entries.english: Wait!\nYou, Trainer over there!<0xFB>Look at my Pokémon.
entries.french_reference: Hé !\nToi, Dresseur, là-bas !\pRegarde mes Pokémon.
entries.portuguese: Espere!\nVocê aí, Treinador!<0xFB>Olhe meus Pokémon.

entries.english: Not bad!\nI like your strength.
entries.french_reference: Pas mal !\nJ'aime ta force.
entries.portuguese: Nada mal!\nGostei da sua força.

entries.english: I'd love to brag about my Pokémon,\nbut nature's calling!
entries.french_reference: J'aimerais vanter mes Pokémon,\nmais la nature m'appelle !
entries.portuguese: Adoraria exibir meus Pokémon,\nmas preciso ir ao banheiro!

entries.english: Two Tamers"<0xFB>One of Dragons, and the other\nof"<0xFB>Wait"<0xFB>What exactly do I tame, again?
entries.french_reference: Deux Dompteurs…\pL'un des Dragons, et l'autre\nde…\pAttends…\pQu'est-ce que je dresse, déjà ?
entries.portuguese: Dois domadores<0xB0><0xFB>Um de dragões, e o outro\nde<0xB0><0xFB>Espera<0xB0><0xFB>O que eu domo mesmo?

entries.english: If I knew what I tamed, we wouldn't\nhave lost.
entries.french_reference: Si je savais ce que je dresse,\non n'aurait pas perdu.
entries.portuguese: Se eu soubesse o que domo,\nnão teríamos perdido.

entries.english: I teamed up with this Dragon Tamer\nto help gain clarity into what<0xFA>exactly I tame.
entries.french_reference: Je me suis allié à ce Dompteur\nDragon pour comprendre ce que\lj'apprivoise vraiment.
entries.portuguese: Me uni a este domador\nde dragões para entender<0xFA>o que eu domo, afinal.

entries.english: Two Tamers"<0xFB>If you want to battle us, you'll\nneed more Pokémon!
entries.french_reference: Deux Dompteurs…\pSi tu veux nous combattre, il te\nfaudra plus de Pokémon !
entries.portuguese: Dois domadores<0xB0><0xFB>Se quiser nos enfrentar,\nvai precisar de mais Pokémon!

entries.english: Druddigon is the Cave Pokémon!<0xFB>I caught mine right here in the\ncaves of Victory Road!
entries.french_reference: Drakkarmin est le Pokémon Caverne !\pJ'ai attrapé le mien ici, dans les\ngrottes de la Route Victoire !
entries.portuguese: Druddigon é o Pokémon Caverna!<0xFB>Peguei o meu aqui nas\ncavernas de Victory Road!

entries.english: No!\nMy Cave Pokémon!
entries.french_reference: Non !\nMon Pokémon Caverne !
entries.portuguese: Não!\nMeu Pokémon Caverna!

entries.english: Gabite is also known as the Cave\nPokémon, but unlike Gabite,<0xFA>Druddigon is a pure Dragon-type.
entries.french_reference: Carmache est aussi un Pokémon\nCaverne, mais contrairement à lui,\lDrakkarmin est de pur type Dragon.
entries.portuguese: Gabite também é conhecido\ncomo Pokémon Caverna, mas<0xFA>Druddigon é só do tipo Dragão.

entries.english: Bring more Pokémon if you want to\nfight my wonderful Cave Pokémon!
entries.french_reference: Reviens avec plus de Pokémon si tu\nveux combattre mon Pokémon Caverne !
entries.portuguese: Traga mais Pokémon para lutar\ncom meu belo Pokémon Caverna!

entries.english: My cousin and I came out here\nbecause I accidentally burned all<0xFA>of his bugs.
entries.french_reference: Mon cousin et moi sommes venus ici\ncar j'ai brûlé par accident\ltous ses Insectes.
entries.portuguese: Meu primo e eu viemos aqui\nporque queimei sem querer<0xFA>todos os insetos dele.

entries.english: Don't worry, his bugs are fine.
entries.french_reference: T'inquiète, ses Insectes vont bien.
entries.portuguese: Os insetos dele estão bem.

entries.english: I convinced my cousin that the\nbest Bug-type could be found in<0xFA>this area of Victory Road.<0xFB>I didn't realize the only Bug-type\naround here is Durant.
entries.french_reference: J'ai convaincu mon cousin que les\nmeilleurs types Insecte se trouvent\ldans cette zone de Route Victoire.\pJe ne pensais pas que le seul type\nInsecte ici serait Fermite.
entries.portuguese: Disse ao meu primo que os\nmelhores Pokémon Inseto ficam<0xFA>nesta área de Victory Road.<0xFB>Não sabia que o único\nInseto daqui era Durant.

entries.english: I brought my cousin here to look\nfor Bug-type Pokémon.<0xFB>Maybe if you had more Pokémon, we\nwould take a break and battle you.
entries.french_reference: J'ai amené mon cousin ici chercher\ndes Pokémon Insecte.\pSi tu avais plus de Pokémon, on\nferait une pause pour te battre.
entries.portuguese: Trouxe meu primo para\nprocurar Pokémon Inseto.<0xFB>Se tivesse mais Pokémon,\nfaríamos uma pausa para lutar.

entries.english: Why is the only Bug-type Pokémon\nhere Durant?<0xFB>My cousin promised me there were\ngreat Bug-type Pokémon here!
entries.french_reference: Pourquoi le seul Pokémon Insecte\nici est Fermite ?\pMon cousin m'avait promis de super\nPokémon Insecte ici !
entries.portuguese: Por que Durant é o único\nPokémon Inseto daqui?<0xFB>Meu primo prometeu que aqui\nhavia ótimos Pokémon Inseto!

entries.english: Cousin!<0xFB>Your Heatmor's trying to eat my\nDurant again!
entries.french_reference: Cousin !\pTon Aflamanoir tente encore de\nmanger mon Fermite !
entries.portuguese: Primo!<0xFB>Seu Heatmor quer comer\nmeu Durant de novo!

entries.english: My cousin's Heatmor is always\ntrying to eat the Durant I caught.
entries.french_reference: L'Aflamanoir de mon cousin\nveut manger mon Fermite attrapé.
entries.portuguese: O Heatmor do meu primo vive\nquerendo comer meu Durant.

entries.english: We're out here looking for bugs.\nBut all I can find is Durant!<0xFB>If you had more Pokémon, I'd fight\nyou to express my frustration.
entries.french_reference: On cherche des Insectes ici.\nMais je ne trouve que des Fermite !\pSi tu avais plus de Pokémon, je te\ncombattrai pour me défouler.
entries.portuguese: Procuramos insetos aqui.\nMas só encontro Durant!<0xFB>Se tivesse mais Pokémon,\nlutaria para me desestressar.

entries.english: Have a little taste of our\nmother-daughter fighting style!
entries.french_reference: Goûte un peu à notre style\nmère-fille !
entries.portuguese: Prove um pouco do nosso\nestilo de luta de mãe e filha!

entries.english: Our mother-daughter combination has\nseen better fights.
entries.french_reference: Notre duo mère-fille a connu\nmieux comme combats.
entries.portuguese: Nossa dupla de mãe e filha\njá teve lutas melhores.

entries.english: My daughter looks up to Arabella\nof the Elite Four.<0xFB>Ever since she could speak, all she\ncould talk about was Arabella.
entries.french_reference: Ma fille admire Arabella\ndu Conseil 4.\pDepuis qu'elle parle, elle ne\nparle que d'Arabella.
entries.portuguese: Minha filha admira Arabella,\nda Elite Four.<0xFB>Desde que aprendeu a falar,\nsó fala de Arabella.

entries.english: If you want to see some beautiful\nmother-daughter power, bring more<0xFA>Pokémon to battle with.
entries.french_reference: Si tu veux voir notre belle force\nmère-fille, viens avec plus de\lPokémon pour combattre.
entries.portuguese: Se quiser ver a bela força\nde mãe e filha, traga mais<0xFA>Pokémon para lutar.

entries.english: Me and Mommy are super strong\nwhen we fight together!
entries.french_reference: Maman et moi sommes super fortes\nquand on combat ensemble !
entries.portuguese: Mamãe e eu somos superfortes\nquando lutamos juntas!

entries.english: Me and Mommy" we lost?
entries.french_reference: Maman et moi… on a perdu ?
entries.portuguese: Mamãe e eu<0xB0> perdemos?

entries.english: I wanna be just like Arabella!<0xFB>Super adorable and super powerful!
entries.french_reference: Je veux être comme Arabella !\pTrop mignonne et super forte !
entries.portuguese: Quero ser como Arabella!<0xFB>Superfofa e superforte!

entries.english: I wanna be just like Arabella!\nShe fights with two Pokémon!
entries.french_reference: Je veux être comme Arabella !\nElle combat avec deux Pokémon !
entries.portuguese: Quero ser como Arabella!\nEla luta com dois Pokémon!

entries.english: I am a Pokémon Ranger!<0xFB>If the hedges are in danger"\nLet me see your Pokémon in battle!
entries.french_reference: Je suis un Ranger Pokémon !\pSi les haies sont en danger…\nMontre-moi tes Pokémon en combat !
entries.portuguese: Sou um Pokémon Ranger!<0xFB>Se as cercas estão em risco<0xB0>\nMostre seus Pokémon na batalha!

entries.english: Your strength is fathomless!\nI am deeply impressed.
entries.french_reference: Ta force est sans limite !\nJe suis très impressionné.
entries.portuguese: Sua força não tem limites!\nEstou muito impressionado.

entries.english: I aim to be the best Pokémon\nRanger in the world!<0xFB>But my first step is to take care\nof these hedges.
entries.french_reference: Je vise à être le meilleur Ranger\nPokémon du monde !\pMais d'abord, je dois m'occuper\nde ces haies.
entries.portuguese: Quero ser o melhor\nPokémon Ranger do mundo!<0xFB>Mas primeiro preciso cuidar\ndestas cercas vivas.

entries.english: It's not enough for me just to be\ntogether with Pokémon!<0xFB>I want to win!
entries.french_reference: Être avec des Pokémon ne suffit\npas !\pJe veux gagner !
entries.portuguese: Só estar com Pokémon\nnão basta para mim!<0xFB>Quero vencer!

entries.english: Ugh! How" How"<0xFB>How could you defeat me this\nutterly!?
entries.french_reference: Argh ! Comment… comment…\pComment as-tu pu me battre\nà ce point !?
entries.portuguese: Argh! Como<0xB0> Como<0xB0><0xFB>Como pôde me derrotar\ntão completamente!?

entries.english: It's not enough for me just to be\ntogether with Pokémon!<0xFB>I want to win!<0xFB>But I do know that some people feel\nat ease just by being with their<0xFA>Pokémon.
entries.french_reference: Être avec des Pokémon ne suffit\npas !\pJe veux gagner !\pMais je sais que certains se\nsentent bien rien qu'avec leurs\lPokémon.
entries.portuguese: Só estar com Pokémon\nnão basta para mim!<0xFB>Quero vencer!<0xFB>Mas sei que algumas pessoas\nficam em paz só de estar<0xFA>com seus Pokémon.

entries.english: Our unity won't be bested by\nanyone!
entries.french_reference: Notre unité ne sera jamais\nsurpassée !
entries.portuguese: Ninguém vai superar\na nossa união!

entries.english: We couldn't win"\nBut that's alright.
entries.french_reference: On n'a pas gagné…\nMais ça ira.
entries.portuguese: Não conseguimos vencer<0xB0>\nMas tudo bem.

entries.english: My Pokémon was once injured badly\nin a fight.<0xFB>I'm just so grateful that we're\nstill together after all that.
entries.french_reference: Mon Pokémon a été gravement blessé\nau combat.\pJe suis si heureux qu'on soit\nencore ensemble malgré tout ça.
entries.portuguese: Meu Pokémon já se feriu\ngravemente numa luta.<0xFB>Sou muito grato por ainda\nestarmos juntos depois disso.

entries.english: I just felt a great wind"\nAre you the one who kicked it up?
entries.french_reference: Je viens de sentir un grand vent…\nC'est toi qui l'as déclenché ?
entries.portuguese: Senti um vento forte<0xB0>\nFoi você que o causou?

entries.english: This defeat will also be blown\nfar away"
entries.french_reference: Cette défaite sera emportée\nau loin…
entries.portuguese: Esta derrota também\nserá levada para longe<0xB0>

entries.english: You are the wind.<0xFB>A supple and comforting wind\nblowing through Victory Road!
entries.french_reference: Tu es le vent.\pUn vent doux et rassurant\nqui souffle sur la Route Victoire !
entries.portuguese: Você é o vento.<0xFB>Um vento suave e acolhedor\nque sopra por Victory Road!

entries.english: A heated battle is good, but get\ntoo hot and you might end up<0xFA>getting burned!
entries.french_reference: Un combat brûlant, c'est bien, mais\nsi ça chauffe trop, on peut\lse brûler !
entries.portuguese: Uma batalha quente é boa, mas,\nse esquentar demais, pode<0xFA>acabar se queimando!

entries.english: Amazing"\nI think I got a bit singed.
entries.french_reference: Incroyable…\nJe crois que j'ai roussi.
entries.portuguese: Incrível<0xB0>\nAcho que me chamusquei.

entries.english: Burning competitiveness and cool\nlogic"<0xFB>You'll need both if you're going to\ngo up against the Pokémon League.
entries.french_reference: Compétition brûlante et logique\nfroide…\pIl te faut les deux pour affronter\nla Ligue Pokémon.
entries.portuguese: Competitividade ardente\ne lógica fria<0xB0><0xFB>Precisa das duas para\nenfrentar a Liga Pokémon.

entries.english: I'm gonna numb you and your\nPokémon!
entries.french_reference: Je vais t'engourdir, toi et tes\nPokémon !
entries.portuguese: Vou paralisar você\ne seus Pokémon!

entries.english: Unbelievable!\nI was the one struck numb"?
entries.french_reference: Incroyable !\nC'est moi qui suis engourdi… ?
entries.portuguese: Inacreditável!\nEu que fiquei paralisado<0xB0>?

entries.english: A fighting style overflowing with\npower or a strategy that excels<0xFA>technically"<0xFB>It depends on the Pokémon, see!
entries.french_reference: Un style débordant de puissance\nou une stratégie très\ltechnique…\pTout dépend du Pokémon !
entries.portuguese: Um estilo cheio de força\nou uma estratégia de<0xFA>excelência técnica<0xB0><0xFB>Depende do Pokémon, sabe!

entries.english: All I want are powerful Pokémon.
entries.french_reference: Je veux des Pokémon puissants.
entries.portuguese: Só quero Pokémon poderosos.

entries.english: I can't comprehend this!\nHow could my partners lose!?
entries.french_reference: Je ne comprends pas !\nComment mes partenaires ont perdu !?
entries.portuguese: Não entendo!\nComo meus parceiros perderam!?

entries.english: All I want are powerful Pokémon!<0xFB>Only a Pokémon that understands\nthat can become one of my partners!
entries.french_reference: Je veux des Pokémon puissants !\pSeul un Pokémon qui comprend\ncela peut devenir mon partenaire !
entries.portuguese: Só quero Pokémon poderosos!<0xFB>Só um Pokémon que entende\nisso pode ser meu parceiro!

entries.english: Are you sure you want to seriously\ntake on someone like me, who<0xFA>seriously fights with her Pokémon?
entries.french_reference: Sûr de vouloir affronter\nquelqu'un comme moi, qui\lcombat à fond avec ses Pokémon ?
entries.portuguese: Quer mesmo enfrentar alguém\ncomo eu, que leva a sério<0xFA>as batalhas com seus Pokémon?

entries.english: This is the pain that comes from\nseriously facing someone head-on"
entries.french_reference: C'est la douleur d'affronter\nquelqu'un de front…
entries.portuguese: Esta é a dor de enfrentar\nalguém de frente, a sério<0xB0>

entries.english: I battle seriously because I am\nafter serious strength.<0xFB>There's nothing worse than a\nhalfhearted opponent.
entries.french_reference: Je combats sérieusement car je\ncherche la vraie puissance.\pRien de pire qu'un\nadversaire tiède.
entries.portuguese: Luto a sério porque busco\nforça de verdade.<0xFB>Nada pior que um adversário\nsem vontade de lutar.

entries.english: Are you sure? I'm strong, you know.\nDo you still want to take me on?
entries.french_reference: Tu es sûr ? Je suis forte, tu sais.\nTu veux quand même me défier ?
entries.portuguese: Tem certeza? Sou forte, sabia?\nAinda quer me enfrentar?

entries.english: Yes, I am sure"\nI am weak, you know.<0xFB>Why did you want to take me on?
entries.french_reference: Oui, bien sûr…\nJe suis faible, tu sais.\pPourquoi voulais-tu m'affronter ?
entries.portuguese: Sim, tenho certeza<0xB0>\nSou fraca, sabia?<0xFB>Por que quis me enfrentar?

entries.english: Not wanting to admit my own limits,\nI am continuing to battle on"<0xFB>That is right!\nAt least I am persistent!
entries.french_reference: Je refuse d'admettre mes limites,\nje continue à me battre…\pC'est ça !\nAu moins, je suis tenace !
entries.portuguese: Não quero admitir meus limites\ne continuo batalhando<0xB0><0xFB>Isso mesmo!\nAo menos sou persistente!

entries.english: The people who pass by here have\nsuch different moods!<0xFB>It is enjoyable to watch, and even\nmore enjoyable to fight against<0xFA>those people!
entries.french_reference: Les gens qui passent ici ont des\nhumeurs si différentes !\pC'est agréable à voir, et encore\nplus agréable de combattre\lces gens !
entries.portuguese: Quem passa por aqui tem\nhumores tão diferentes!<0xFB>É divertido observar,\ne mais divertido ainda<0xFA>enfrentar essas pessoas!

entries.english: Mwahaha!\nIt is fun!
entries.french_reference: Mwahaha !\nC'est amusant !
entries.portuguese: Muahaha!\nÉ divertido!

entries.english: Your Pokémon was in a really good\nmood the moment that you won!<0xFB>However"<0xFB>Your mood will worsen as you see\nwhat is on the other side of this<0xFA>entryway"
entries.french_reference: Tes Pokémon étaient de très bonne\nhumeur quand tu as gagné !\pCependant…\pTon humeur va empirer en voyant\nce qui se trouve de l'autre côté\lde cette entrée…
entries.portuguese: Seu Pokémon ficou de ótimo\nhumor quando você venceu!<0xFB>Porém<0xB0><0xFB>Seu humor vai piorar quando\nvir o que está do outro lado<0xFA>desta passagem<0xB0>

entries.english: <0xFC>ÀÉHaaahraaan!
entries.french_reference: {COLOR}ÉHaaahraaan!
entries.portuguese: <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Haaahraaan!
